title: Indicate use of artificial intelligence

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Carry provenance disclosure into asset handling so synthetic content remains identifiable when shared.
strategic_value: Repeating the AI condition near image resources can help Helsinki keep disclosure attached to production work.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture repeats the condition for wholly generated or meaning-changing AI content and the watermark/text/audio instruction without the earlier section’s sample statements.
practical_value: Retain the disclosure instruction during image handling and do not assume missing sample wording adds another rule.

content_islands.name: Condition and method
content_islands.spec: Keep the AI-use condition above the marking-method line; preserve the absence of further wording examples.

reference_purposes.Application: It instructs the use of watermark and text or audio to mark relevant content.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The condition is wholly AI-produced content or significant modification that changes meaning.
